# Tradewerx Appliance Service

> Independent luxury appliance repair and maintenance, owned and operated by Justin Keatts.
> Based in Lenoir, North Carolina. Travels throughout western North Carolina, eastern
> Tennessee, upstate South Carolina and southern Virginia, and further when the job justifies it.

## Facts

- Business name: Tradewerx Inc., trading as Tradewerx Appliance Service
- Owner and technician: Justin Keatts, 20+ years in the trades, serving first responder
- Base: Lenoir, North Carolina
- Email: tradewerx.inc@gmail.com
- Service area: western North Carolina, eastern Tennessee, upstate South Carolina, southern Virginia
- Warranty: out of warranty work booked directly. For covered repairs, customers can request
  Tradewerx through their manufacturer or service plan administrator. Direct brand
  authorization is being established.
- Scheduling: routed by drive time from Lenoir. A distant job may be the only call that day,
  while work close to home can run up to eight calls in a day.
- Discount: standing discount for active duty military, veterans and first responders.

## Brands serviced

Blue Star, Miele, Wolf, Viking, Thermador, Bosch, Gaggenau, True, Speed Queen, Sub-Zero,
Cove, U-Line, Scotsman, Fisher & Paykel, Liebherr, Bertazzoni, Aga, Marvel, DCS, Asko.

## Appliance categories

Refrigerators (freestanding and built in), freezers, under counter wine coolers, under counter
beverage centers, under counter ice makers, dishwashers, freestanding ranges, microwaves,
wall ovens, trash compactors, coffee makers, grills, ventilation, laundry.

## Beyond repair

Appliance installation, panel installation for panel ready appliances, pre purchase home
inspection, second opinion diagnosis, dryer vent cleaning, refrigerator coil cleaning,
ice machine descaling and sanitizing, annual maintenance visits.

## Common questions

Q: Why is my refrigerator not cooling but the freezer still works?
A: A warm fresh food side with a cold freezer points at airflow between the compartments
   rather than the compressor. Usual causes are a failed evaporator fan, a defrost fault
   icing the coil, or a damper stuck closed. Clear the interior vents and vacuum the
   condenser coils before calling.

Q: Why is my dishwasher not draining?
A: The drain path is blocked or the pump has failed. Clear the filter in the bottom of the
   tub and check the air gap at the sink. On Miele this shows as F24, on Bosch as E24.

Q: Why does my dryer take two cycles to dry a load?
A: Restricted venting, far more often than a failed heating element. Cleaning the duct
   restores airflow, cuts drying time and removes a fire risk.

Q: Why is my ice maker not making ice?
A: Start at the water supply, then look at scale on the evaporator. In under counter
   machines from Scotsman, U-Line and Marvel, descaling often restores production.

Q: Why is my wine cooler not holding temperature?
A: Compact condensers need clear airflow. Check the front grille and the coils, and consider
   ambient heat from an adjacent oven or dishwasher.

Q: Can I request Tradewerx for a warranty repair?
A: Yes. Ask your manufacturer or service plan administrator to send Tradewerx.

Q: Do you offer a military or first responder discount?
A: Yes, on every visit, for active duty military, veterans and first responders.
